analysis.investment_thesis: Central Bank of India is a government-owned PSB — explicitly excluded from the Magic Formula because bank capital structures make EBIT/EV and ROIC meaningless. Even setting the exclusion aside, the bank logged losses for six consecutive years (2016–2021) and its ROCE of only 5.48% is well below any threshold that would interest me.
key_strengths: Recent profitability turnaround: net profit rose from ₹1,083 Cr (2022) to ₹3,943 Cr (2025), showing the NPA cleanup is bearing fruit
P/B of 0.82x — below book — offers a statistical margin of safety for those who invest in banks on book value
Other income growing at 12.9% CAGR (₹5,996 Cr in 2025) indicates improving fee income diversification
key_risks: Six consecutive years of losses (2016–2021) destroyed enormous shareholder value; accumulated losses are a structural legacy the bank must work through
Revenue CAGR of only 3% over 9 years — barely keeping pace with inflation — in a sector that should be growing with India's economy
OCF positive in only 1 of 5 years; operating cash flows are highly volatile and reflect inherent unpredictability of loan book quality
red_flags: Government owns 89.27% — PSBs are subject to political lending mandates that can override commercial discipline at any time
ROCE of 5.48% is far below cost of capital; the bank is not generating economic profit
Magic Formula explicitly excludes banks and financial companies — I cannot rank this stock and will not try
analysis.detailed_analysis: My Magic Formula was built to find good businesses cheaply, and I defined 'good' by eliminating businesses where capital structure makes the metrics uninterpretable — banks are the prime example. CENTRALBK's balance sheet has ₹504,923 Cr of assets funded predominantly by deposits; 'earnings yield' and 'return on capital' in the traditional sense don't apply. The underlying credit quality story is cautiously improving, but this is a turnaround trade in a government-controlled institution, not the kind of high-ROIC compounder my formula seeks.
